fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (around 0x710068aa84) stores vptr 0x7104f74170 then stores the object at boma+0xD8.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the boma register here (the same register that receives the module at +0xD8); set_team's notify path reads [+0x8] to broadcast an event.

fields.name: team_no
fields.evidence: team_no slot (+0x50, f_71004dfe40) loads it. set_team (export f_710208a910 calls vtable +0x60 = f_71004dfe60) writes it and +0x28 only when it changes, and when its bool is set broadcasts event 0x1C (team changed) with the new team to listeners. init (+0x28, f_71004df970) writes arg1 here; reset (+0x30, f_71004dfb30) sets -1. Slot +0x48 returns the address of this 12-byte group (team, second, flag).

fields.name: team_second_no
fields.evidence: team_second_no slot (+0x58, f_71004dfe50) loads it; set_team_second (+0x68, f_71004dff40) writes it and +0x2C. Init/reset -1.

fields.name: team_group_flag
fields.evidence: Third member of the 12-byte {team, second, flag} group whose address slot +0x48 returns; constructor, init and reset clear it; no export reads it.

fields.name: hit_team_no
fields.evidence: hit_team_no slot (+0x78, f_71004dff60) loads it; set_hit_team (+0x88, f_71004dff80) writes it if different; init writes arg2; slot +0x70 returns the address of this group. set_team_owner_id calls set_hit_team with the owner's team when the hit team equalled the own team.

fields.name: hit_team_second_no
fields.evidence: hit_team_second_no slot (+0x80, f_71004dff70) loads it; set_hit_team_second (+0x90, f_71004dffa0) stores it.

fields.name: hit_team_group_flag
fields.evidence: Flag of the hit-team group; cleared by constructor/init/reset; no export reads it.

fields.name: team_no_copy
fields.evidence: Third team group: set_team writes the same value as +0x10; init writes its arg3; slot +0x98 (f_71004dffb0) returns the address of this group. Which system reads it is not identified.

fields.name: team_second_no_copy
fields.evidence: set_team_second writes the same value as +0x14.

fields.name: team_owner_id
fields.evidence: team_owner_id slot (+0xA8, f_71004e02a0) loads it. set_team_owner_id (+0xA0, f_71004dffc0): for 0x50000000 (no object) stores that and resets +0x38..+0x4C; otherwise looks the battle object up and stores the owner's own team_owner_id (following the chain to the root) or the owner's id when that is invalid; then copies the root's identity into +0x38..+0x4C and takes the owner's team (set_team with notify). Initial 0x50000000 = invalid battle object id.

fields.name: team_owner_category
fields.how: computed: top 4 bits of the owner's battle object id
fields.evidence: set_team_owner_id stores (owner id >> 28); slot +0xB0 (f_71004e02b0) loads it. Initial 6 = BATTLE_OBJECT_CATEGORY_INVALID (lua_const); 0 = FIGHTER.

fields.name: team_owner_kind
fields.evidence: set_team_owner_id copies the owner battle object's +0xC word (its kind); slot +0xB8 (f_71004e02c0) loads it; init -1.

fields.name: team_owner_entry_id
fields.how: computed: owner object's +0x10 word if its category is fighter, else -1

fields.name: team_owner_flag
fields.evidence: Slot +0xC8 (f_71004e02e0) stores arg&1; constructor/init/reset set 1. No export reads it.

fields.name: metamon_owner_object_id
fields.evidence: set_team_owner_id: when the owner object answers true to its virtual +0x468, stores its virtual +0x470 result here (an object id, init 0x50000000) and its +0x478 result at +0x4C; slot +0xD0 (f_71004e02f0) loads it.

fields.name: metamon_owner_fighter_entry_id
fields.evidence: metamon_owner_fighter_entry_id slot (+0xD8, f_71004e0300) loads it; written by set_team_owner_id from the owner's virtual +0x478; init -1.

notes: Single class (80 bytes). Teams are three 12-byte groups {team, second team, u8 flag} at +0x10 (team), +0x1C (hit team), +0x28 (copy written along with team); slots +0x48/+0x70/+0x98 return their addresses. init (+0x28) takes (team, hit_team, third); reset (+0x30) sets all to -1, owner fields to invalid, and notifies listeners. set_team's bool = broadcast event 0x1C. set_team_owner_id makes owned objects inherit the root owner's team. Initial values: team ints -1, owner id 0x50000000, category 6, +0x44 = 1.
